}}'''Iona''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' and the roommate of [[Bethamin Zeami]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Iona}}

==History==
She is one of the two others that [[Bethamin]] shares a room with in [[The Golden Swans of Heaven]] in [[Ebou Dar]].

When [[Almurat Mor]] asks Bethamin if she has any wine or brandy, she replies that Iona has a flask of the local brandy; Almurat tells her to pour him some.
